title: The Gilded Reach
description: The golden meadow: gold turf and grass, teal water, giant Lumineshrooms, and the star the Sunstorms break from.

title: Nebula Fields
description: An emission nebula on the ground: rose moss, magenta reeds with cold-blue tips, Drift Bladders, low gravity.

title: Ashen Barrens
description: The Leviathans' graveyard: pale stone, bone spires and ribcages under falling ash.

title: Deep Hollows
description: The End's only forest: dark Nullwood on ring islands, Hollow Vines and Null Lanterns.

title: Glimmering Crags
description: Dark Nightstone peaks grown through with cold, glowing Glimmer Crystal.

title: The Leviathan
description: A Star Leviathan's skeleton adrift over the void, with an End City citadel built along its spine.

title: The Reliquary
description: The ribcage cathedral where the Curator waits - and its ceiling, where the second phase is fought.

title: Its heart
description: In the Leviathan's ribcage, its heart still beats.

title: The Curator
description: The keeper of the reliquary: a war-construct with a cannon arm. Defeat it for the only Starforge Templates.

title: The Curator, turned over
description: At half health its case shatters and the fight turns upside down.

title: Drift Whale
description: A Drift Whale over the Ashen Barrens. Pods fly as a flock; sing one a song and it's yours to ride.

title: Hushback
description: A clear-hided grazer of the Gilded Reach. The herd keeps a lookout - sneak up on it.

title: Hydragrip
description: A dark newt lit with cyan; it keeps the herds clean of endermites and coughs up their pearls.

title: Mirror Wretch
description: It calls you in voices you know from the void's edge - and hums at whales in their own.

title: The Watcher
description: Seen only from the corner of your eye; it leads you to the Leviathan.

title: Shardback
description: Folded down in its geode, it looks like one more crystal cluster - until you come close.

title: Solar Array
description: Cracked Solarite mirrors round a reflecting pool in the Gilded Reach, still focusing the Sunstorms.
